scope: Focused source geometry, native collision/navigation (no slide), actual bearing/support-loss and renderer registration for the live H15 access variant. No fire replay, full action library, live-game frame-rate or final combined release acceptance.

quantities.convention: Unchanged prototype native frame density, one finite unit per m2 of 0.12m floor slab; not measured mass.

support.scope: Isolated H15 with the actual manifest-qualified explicit host flight and both named landings; retained native inferred stringer model

Native guard dimensions and all painting attributes retained
Aperture matches floor records, level geometry, painted source and fuel
Real native bearing solids, seated post bases and rail contacts
Native 1m diameter / 1.66m body ascends and descends at five lateral offsets
Original floor-lip failure remains a failing control with unchanged body
All changed pieces rooted; physical bearer retirement removes post support
Removing actual edge geometry and its physical source blocks the landing crossing

Shop geometry, contents and native stair remain the original control
Original fixtures and evidence preserved; authored JS retains matching normalized source
limitations: The existing flight uses the inherited inferred stringer; these added posts and bearers have measured contacts.
Body-cylinder fitting does not prove every posed species/equipment envelope.
Original 2db phone/fire/cache captures keep their original input pin. The architect/coder own the new combined keyboard/input/build gate.
